content: s5-rs defines a low-level async Store trait (put_stream, put_bytes, exists, open_read_stream, open_read_bytes, size, list, delete, rename, provide, sync) with StoreFeatures capability flags (supports_rename, case_sensitive, recommended_max_dir_size, supports_reflink) and separate higher-level BlobStore facade that does hash verification; backends: Memory (budgeted W-TinyLFU or unbounded), Local, S3 (rust-s3, path-style, Range reads, presigned GET for provide), Sia renterd, Indexd (Sia storage SDK with sealed-object cache), Fjall (packs small blobs into SSTs); sync() is an explicit durability barrier; modified() returns mtime for fail-safe GC; Pins trait prevents GC; registry (mutable pointers) fully separate from blob storage.
